title: Model Definitions
description: Validates models.json AND <provider>-models.json (profile-level provider model files). Model ids are arbitrary keys; each entry must carry a 'name'. 'variants' is a map of named reasoning overlays: each value is a settings object whose keys follow the provider's reasoning format - reasoningEffort (opencode / openai), thinking.type + thinking.budgetTokens (claude), or thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget (gemini).

variants.description: Named reasoning overlays (e.g. { low: { reasoningEffort: low } }). Supported settings keys include reasoningEffort, thinking.budgetTokens, thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget; additional keys are allowed and pass through unchanged.
